directions: All3 positive axes; retain individual complex-axis correlations and average REAL parts.
regular_sampling: Every100cycles, including warmup in saved derived history. Central estimates use cycles>1000; dense diagnostic/adaptively retained fields not pooled.
statistical_plan: Use matching-checkpoint m2,S0,F,winding2 and G histories. Blocks expressed in original cycle units: max dense monitored tau and100*G/checkpoint tau; do not regard checkpoints as independent. Log applied only to ensemble means/draws; preserve invalid tails. Pilot before expansion; no fixed-q slope interpreted as asymptotic Delta.
